description: This file declares functions and structures for an Open Content Decryption Module (OpenCDM) adapter, including session private data management and decryption functions for media buffers, intended for use with GStreamer buffers and caps.

methods.name: opencdm_construct_session_private
methods.description: Creates private data for a given OpenCDMSession, returning an opaque pointer.

methods.name: opencdm_destruct_session_private
methods.description: Destroys private data associated with an OpenCDMSession.

methods.name: opencdm_gstreamer_session_decrypt
methods.description: Performs decryption on a session using buffers for encrypted data, subsamples, IV, and key ID.

methods.name: opencdm_gstreamer_session_decrypt_buffer
methods.description: Performs decryption on a session using buffers and caps, with metadata for subsample info.
